title: Temporary Tables
description: Learn how to create and manage temporary tables for intermediate result storage.

data.text: Temporary tables are tables that exist temporarily on SQL Server. They are useful for storing intermediate result sets that are accessed multiple times.

data.title: Create temp table with SELECT INTO
data.content: Creates a local temporary table using SELECT INTO.
data.code:
SELECT
    product_name,
    list_price
INTO #trek_products
FROM
    production.products
WHERE
    brand_id = 9;

data.title: Create temp table with CREATE TABLE
data.content: Creates a local temporary table with explicit column definitions.

data.text: Global temporary tables start with ## and are accessible across connections:

data.title: Global temporary table
data.content: Creates a global temporary table accessible from any session.

data.title: Temporary Tables Key Points
points: Local temp tables start with # and are session-scoped.
Global temp tables start with ## and are accessible across sessions.
Temp tables are stored in the tempdb database.
SQL Server drops temp tables automatically when the session ends.
